summary: The RptMnuReport_Wizards is a part of the HSPnet.UserControls.ReportMenu namespace, responsible for managing report wizards in a web application. It includes functionalities to handle user sessions and operations related to report wizard interactions.
purpose: To facilitate the management and interaction with report wizards within a web-based application, leveraging user sessions for personalized operations.

fields.name: gridData
fields.description: A GridView control for displaying data.

fields.name: dsWizards
fields.description: An ObjectDataSource control for binding data to the GridView.

fields.name: blnPlacingUser
fields.description: Boolean indicating if the user is a placing user.

fields.name: blnReceivingUser
fields.description: Boolean indicating if the user is a receiving user.

workflows.name: Selecting Data Source
steps: If null, cancel the data source selection.
If not null, set InputParameters for Sess, PA, and RA using UserSession, blnPlacingUser, and blnReceivingUser respectively.

workflows.name: Handling GridView Command
steps: Listen for command events on gridData.
If command is 'cmdWizards', cache the UserSession and redirect to ReportWizardMenu.aspx with appropriate query strings.

business_rules: If UserSession is null during data source selection, the operation is cancelled.
system_behavior: Data source operations depend on user session states.
Command events on the GridView control trigger specific navigation actions.
exceptions: Operation cancelled if UserSession is null during data source selection.
